name: Avalanche Hound
ability: Alpine Spirit / Thick Fat / Liquid Courage (hidden)
look: a massive heroic mountain dog with two iron-banded oak barrels strapped on its shoulders like cannon pods
entry: A massive, heroic canine wearing two heavy oak barrels strapped across its broad shoulders like cannon pods. It charges through ten-foot snowdrifts effortlessly, launching pressurized blasts of warming tonic to shatter ice walls.
how: Evolve Kegguard at level 40 in a snowy area. It learns Close Combat when it evolves.
Wild: rare in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
